title: Add oxygen at the end
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: An aldehyde can be oxidized to a carboxylic acid. The aldehyde carbon keeps its carbonyl oxygen and gains an OH group to form ethanoic acid.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of ethanal under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Ethanal is treated with an aqueous oxidant. Which major organic product forms after workup? An aldehyde can be oxidized to a carboxylic acid. The aldehyde carbon keeps its carbonyl oxygen and gains an OH group to form ethanoic acid.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
